shortDescription: DCNM ansible module for managing Links.

options.name: config
options.description: A list of dictionaries containing Links information.

options.name: deploy
options.description: Flag to control deployment of links. If set to 'true' then the links included will be deployed to specified switches. If set to 'false', the links will be created but not deployed. Setting this flag to 'true' will result in all pending configurations on the source and destination devices to be deployed.

options.name: src_fabric
options.description: Name of the source fabric for links operations.

options.name: state
options.description: The required state of the configuration after module completion.
